title: Create an HTML file
learningObjectives: Identify and assemble the parts of a complete HTML document

understand.concept: Create index.html in a project folder, save it as plain text, and open it in a browser.
understand.whyItMatters: A local HTML file can be opened directly by a browser; the extension helps tools identify its format.
understand.analogy: A recipe card labels a recipe, but the browser does not interpret every instruction like a person.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a memory aid; HTML should not be interpreted literally through it.

explain.narrative: Create index.html in a project folder, save it as plain text, and open it in a browser.

practise.guidedTask: Create about.html beside index.html and give it a different heading.
practise.independentTask: Create your own small page, open it in a browser and inspect the result.
hints: Check that each element is nested under the correct parent.
